title: The Architecture of Trust: A Framework for AI-Augmented Real Estate Valuation in the Era of Structured Data
reasoning: The paper includes a substantial component on algorithmic justice, accountability, and ethics. It dedicates Section 4 specifically to 'Trust, Accountability, and Systemic Risk Management,' and Section 4.2 to 'Algorithmic Justice.'
